acceptance: A deterministic, single-threaded cooperative scheduler with virtual time exists identically in the Rust VM and the JavaScript runtime: depth-first await driving, FIFO run queue, and a clock that only advances at sleep/deadline points

task.spawn, task.sleep, task.all, task.race, task.timeout, task.cancel and task.group behave as recorded in ADP-006 section E, including fail-fast joins, order-deterministic race, deadline cancellation and group wait

The await opcode resolves completed tasks inline, suspends a waiter with its operand stack and instruction pointer intact, faults on an await cycle with AIPO_RT_AWAIT_CYCLE, faults when driving a cancelled task with AIPO_RT_CANCELLED, and rejects blocking inside a synchronous host callback with AIPO_RT_AWAIT_IN_CALLBACK
VM and JS produce identical stdout, diagnostic codes and exit status over the conformance corpus and the Wave 3 async programs (differential suite green)
cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace --all-targets and cargo doc --workspace --no-deps are all green
